product: Due North — invoice follow-up for independent studios
audience: Studio owners who need to chase late invoices without maintaining a spreadsheet
primary_task: Find the most urgent overdue invoice, review its history, and prepare a reminder
scope: Dashboard, invoice detail, reminder draft and confirmation; local demonstration only
stack: Use the existing repository stack; if empty, choose the smallest suitable web stack
direction: Calm, precise, trustworthy. Warm-neutral surfaces, ink typography, restrained blue actions. Show the actual workflow, not decorative analytics.
content: Use realistic invoice dates and amounts. Label all records as sample data; never imply a reminder email was sent.
acceptance: At 360px and 1440px, the next overdue invoice and primary action remain discoverable
Selecting an invoice opens its actual sample details
Editing and preparing a reminder preserves the text and shows an explicit demo confirmation
Empty filters, invalid email, loading, and failure states have recovery paths
Normal text contrast and keyboard focus are verified
